name: Marcus

description.en: Businessman on a lunch break. Wants it done right, and fast.
description.vi: Doanh nhân giờ nghỉ trưa. Muốn làm kỹ, và nhanh.

wants: A neat men's manicure before a big meeting: short square nails, clear or nude, buffed. He has 40 minutes and asks how long it takes and what it costs before starting, and wants to book a regular time every two weeks.
personality: Polite, direct and busy. He checks the time, likes clear answers about time and price, and appreciates a professional stylist. He gets short if answers are vague, and warm when the stylist is efficient.
openingLine: Hi there. I have a meeting at two. Can you do a quick, clean manicure in forty minutes? How much is it?
